
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(synExtra)
library(fst)
library(data.table)
library(powerjoin)
library(readxl)
library(qs2)

synapser::synLogin()

syn <- synDownloader("~/data", .cache = TRUE)
```

```{r}
klaeger_ic50s <- syn("syn51288931") |>
  read_csv()

kinomescan_kd_fits <- syn("syn69680641") |>
  read_csv()

kinomescan_classes <- syn("syn51080579") |>
  read_csv()

kinomescan_kinase_info <- syn("syn51286743") |>
  read_csv()

single_dose <- syn("syn26486828") |>
  read_csv()

chembl_kd_filtered <- syn("syn77771309") |>
  read_csv()

saifudeen_kd_raw <- syn("syn77581842") |>
  read_csv()
```


```{r}
kinomescan_kd_fits_comp <- kinomescan_kd_fits |>
  filter(
    dataset == "original_repeat_replaced",
    !exclude_target,
    rhat < 1.01,
    classification != "discordant"
  ) |>
  transmute(
    lspci_id, name, Symbol = `Entrez Gene Symbol`,
    kd = pmin(kd, 10000),
    classification
  ) |>
  # aggregate to kinase level by taking the most potent kd per kinase
  group_by(lspci_id, Symbol) |>
  slice_min(kd, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup()

klaeger_ic50_comp <- klaeger_ic50s |>
  transmute(
    lspci_id, Symbol = Name,
    IC50 = pmin(IC50, 10000)
  ) |>
  power_inner_join(
    kinomescan_kd_fits_comp,
    by = c("lspci_id", "Symbol"),
    check = check_specs(
      unmatched_keys_left = "info",
      unmatched_keys_right = "info",
      duplicate_keys_left = "warn",
      duplicate_keys_right = "warn"
    )
  )

p <- klaeger_ic50_comp |>
  ggplot(
    # aes(value, pseudo_ic50, color = classification, shape = pseudo_ic50_relation)
    aes(IC50, kd)
  ) +
  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.5,
    shape = 16,
    size = 1
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = paste0("  R = ", signif(r, 2))
    ),
    x = -Inf, y = Inf,
    hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
    data = \(x) tibble(
      r = cor(log10(x$IC50), log10(x$kd), method = "pearson", use = "complete.obs")
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_number(big.mark = "")) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = scales::label_number(big.mark = "")) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    x = "Kd Klaeger",
    y = "Kd Kinomescan"
  )
ggsave(
  "plots/klaeger_kd_vs_kinomescan_kd.pdf", p,
  width = 3, height = 3
)


```

## Saifudeen

Saifudeen Kds were fit with the same Bayesian model as the Kinomescan data
(`fit_kd_gujral.py`). `kd_log` is the natural log of the Kd in M.

```{r}
saifudeen_cdk_map <- c(
  "CDK4+CCND1" = "CDK4-cyclinD1",
  "CDK4+CCND3" = "CDK4-cyclinD3"
)

saifudeen_kd_comp <- saifudeen_kd_raw |>
  filter(
    status == "ok",
    kd_log_r_hat < 1.01
  ) |>
  transmute(
    lspci_id,
    Symbol = target |> recode(!!!saifudeen_cdk_map),
    saifudeen_kd = pmin(exp(kd_log_mean) * 1e9, 10000)
  )

saifudeen_vs_kinomescan <- saifudeen_kd_comp |>
  power_inner_join(
    kinomescan_kd_fits_comp,
    by = c("lspci_id", "Symbol"),
    check = check_specs(
      unmatched_keys_left = "info",
      unmatched_keys_right = "info",
      duplicate_keys_left = "warn",
      duplicate_keys_right = "warn"
    )
  )

saifudeen_kd_comp |>
  distinct(Symbol) |>
  arrange(Symbol) |>
  anti_join(
    kinomescan_kd_fits_comp,
    by = c("Symbol")
  ) |>
  View()

p <- saifudeen_vs_kinomescan |>
  ggplot(
    aes(saifudeen_kd, kd)
  ) +
  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.5,
    shape = 16,
    size = 1
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = paste0("  R = ", signif(r, 2))
    ),
    x = -Inf, y = Inf,
    hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
    data = \(x) tibble(
      r = cor(log10(x$saifudeen_kd), log10(x$kd), method = "pearson", use = "complete.obs")
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_number(big.mark = "")) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = scales::label_number(big.mark = "")) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    x = "Kd Saifudeen",
    y = "Kd Kinomescan"
  )

ggsave(
  "plots/saifudeen_kd_vs_kinomescan_kd.pdf", p,
  width = 3, height = 3
)
```

## Enrichment of >10-fold disagreement versus Kinomescan

Test Klaeger and Saifudeen separately.
Each compound–kinase pair contributes once. For kinase enrichment, shuffle
disagreement labels within compounds; for compound enrichment, shuffle within
kinases. Simulating hypergeometric counts gives the same per-entity null
distribution as these shuffles, without repeatedly shuffling the entire table.
The one-sided p-value tests for more disagreements than expected under this null.
BH correction covers all kinase and compound tests in both datasets.
Directional counts include only >10-fold disagreements: higher Kinomescan Kd
means weaker binding, and lower Kinomescan Kd means stronger binding.

```{r}
disagreement_pairs <- bind_rows(
  klaeger_ic50_comp |>
    transmute(dataset = "Klaeger", lspci_id, Symbol,
              external_value = IC50, kd),
  saifudeen_vs_kinomescan |>
    transmute(dataset = "Saifudeen", lspci_id, Symbol,
              external_value = saifudeen_kd, kd)
) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(lspci_id), !is.na(Symbol),
    is.finite(external_value), external_value > 0,
    is.finite(kd), kd > 0
  ) |>
  mutate(disagree = abs(log10(kd) - log10(external_value)) > 1)

# Fail rather than silently count duplicate pairs as independent measurements.
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(disagreement_pairs[c("dataset", "lspci_id", "Symbol")]))

stratified_enrichment <- function(pairs, entity_col, stratum_col, n_perm = 100000L) {
  stopifnot(nrow(pairs) > 0, n_perm > 0)
  strata <- pairs |>
    group_by(.data[[stratum_col]]) |>
    summarise(n = n(), n_disagree = sum(disagree), .groups = "drop")

  map_dfr(unique(pairs[[entity_col]]), function(entity_id) {
    entity_pairs <- pairs[pairs[[entity_col]] == entity_id, ]
    coverage <- entity_pairs |>
      count(.data[[stratum_col]], name = "n_entity") |>
      left_join(strata, by = stratum_col)

    # Draw the number of discordant pairs assigned to this entity in each stratum.
    null_counts <- numeric(n_perm)
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(coverage))) {
      null_counts <- null_counts + rhyper(
        n_perm, coverage$n_disagree[i],
        coverage$n[i] - coverage$n_disagree[i], coverage$n_entity[i]
      )
    }

    observed <- sum(entity_pairs$disagree)
    expected <- sum(coverage$n_entity * coverage$n_disagree / coverage$n)
    tibble(
      entity = as.character(entity_id),
      n_pairs = nrow(entity_pairs),
      n_disagree = observed,
      n_kinomescan_higher = sum(entity_pairs$disagree & entity_pairs$kd > entity_pairs$external_value),
      n_kinomescan_lower = sum(entity_pairs$disagree & entity_pairs$kd < entity_pairs$external_value),
      disagreement_rate = observed / nrow(entity_pairs),
      expected_disagreements = expected,
      fold_enrichment = if (expected > 0) observed / expected else NA_real_,
      p_value = (1 + sum(null_counts >= observed)) / (n_perm + 1)
    )
  })
}

disagreement_enrichment <- withr::with_seed(
  42,
  disagreement_pairs |>
    (\(pairs) split(pairs, pairs$dataset))() |>
    imap_dfr(function(pairs, dataset_name) {
      bind_rows(
        kinase = stratified_enrichment(pairs, "Symbol", "lspci_id"),
        compound = stratified_enrichment(pairs, "lspci_id", "Symbol"),
        .id = "entity_type"
      ) |>
        mutate(dataset = dataset_name, .before = 1)
    }) |>
    mutate(q_value = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) |>
    arrange(q_value, p_value)
)

write_csv(
  disagreement_enrichment |>
    inner_Join,
  "classification/external_disagreement_enrichment.csv"
)
disagreement_enrichment |>
  filter(q_value < 0.05)
```

## Check global offsets and slopes

The >10-fold definition measures absolute agreement with the identity line.
An assay-wide offset or slope can therefore contribute to kinase enrichment.
These fits are diagnostics, not replacements for the original disagreement calls.
Compare all capped pairs with pairs below 10,000 nM in both assays; the latter
avoid the cap pile-up but still represent a selected subset.

OLS predicts Kinomescan from the external assay. Deming regression allows error
in both axes; lambda is the Kinomescan/external log-scale error variance ratio.
Its unknown value is checked at 0.25, 1 and 4. Bootstrap intervals resample whole
compounds, retaining their kinase measurements, conditional on the kinase panel.

```{r}
calibration_coefficients <- function(d, lambda = 1) {
  sxx <- var(d$x)
  syy <- var(d$y)
  sxy <- cov(d$x, d$y)
  deming_slope <- (syy - lambda * sxx +
    sqrt((syy - lambda * sxx)^2 + 4 * lambda * sxy^2)) / (2 * sxy)
  c(
    mean_offset = mean(d$y - d$x),
    ols_intercept = mean(d$y) - sxy / sxx * mean(d$x),
    ols_slope = sxy / sxx,
    deming_intercept = mean(d$y) - deming_slope * mean(d$x),
    deming_slope = deming_slope
  )
}

set.seed(42)
calibration_summary <- disagreement_pairs |>
  mutate(x = log10(external_value), y = log10(kd)) |>
  (\(pairs) split(pairs, pairs$dataset))() |>
  imap_dfr(function(pairs, dataset_name) {
    bind_rows(
      all_capped = pairs,
      below_cap = pairs |> filter(external_value < 10000, kd < 10000),
      .id = "fit_subset"
    ) |>
      group_by(fit_subset) |>
      group_modify(function(d, key) {
        coefficients <- calibration_coefficients(d)
        compound_rows <- split(seq_len(nrow(d)), d$lspci_id)
        bootstrap <- replicate(1000, {
          sampled <- sample.int(length(compound_rows), replace = TRUE)
          calibration_coefficients(d[unlist(compound_rows[sampled]), ])
        })
        intervals <- t(apply(bootstrap, 1, quantile, probs = c(0.025, 0.975)))
        delta <- d$y - d$x
        tibble(
          n_pairs = nrow(d),
          n_compounds = n_distinct(d$lspci_id),
          median_offset = median(delta),
          deming_slope_lambda025 = calibration_coefficients(d, 0.25)[["deming_slope"]],
          deming_slope_lambda4 = calibration_coefficients(d, 4)[["deming_slope"]],
          raw_disagreement_rate = mean(abs(delta) > 1),
          offset_adjusted_rate = mean(abs(delta - coefficients[["mean_offset"]]) > 1),
          ols_adjusted_rate = mean(abs(d$y - coefficients[["ols_intercept"]] -
            coefficients[["ols_slope"]] * d$x) > 1),
          deming_adjusted_rate = mean(abs(d$y - coefficients[["deming_intercept"]] -
            coefficients[["deming_slope"]] * d$x) > 1)
        ) |>
          bind_cols(as_tibble_row(coefficients)) |>
          bind_cols(as_tibble_row(setNames(intervals[, 1], paste0(names(coefficients), "_lower")))) |>
          bind_cols(as_tibble_row(setNames(intervals[, 2], paste0(names(coefficients), "_upper"))))
      }) |>
      ungroup() |>
      mutate(dataset = dataset_name, .before = 1)
  })

write_csv(calibration_summary, "classification/external_calibration_summary.csv")
calibration_summary

calibration_plot_data <- disagreement_pairs |>
  mutate(x = log10(external_value), y = log10(kd)) |>
  (\(pairs) bind_rows(
    all_capped = pairs,
    below_cap = pairs |> filter(external_value < 10000, kd < 10000),
    .id = "fit_subset"
  ))()

calibration_lines <- bind_rows(
  calibration_summary |> transmute(dataset, fit_subset, fit = "Identity", intercept = 0, slope = 1),
  calibration_summary |> transmute(dataset, fit_subset, fit = "Offset", intercept = mean_offset, slope = 1),
  calibration_summary |> transmute(dataset, fit_subset, fit = "OLS", intercept = ols_intercept, slope = ols_slope),
  calibration_summary |> transmute(dataset, fit_subset, fit = "Deming (lambda = 1)", intercept = deming_intercept, slope = deming_slope)
)

p <- ggplot(calibration_plot_data, aes(x, y)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.08, size = 0.5) +
  geom_abline(data = calibration_lines, aes(intercept = intercept, slope = slope, color = fit)) +
  facet_grid(fit_subset ~ dataset) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x = "log10 external Kd (nM)", y = "log10 Kinomescan Kd (nM)", color = "Fit") +
  theme_bw()
ggsave("plots/external_calibration.png", p, width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 180)
p
```
